column1: # Same-process shadow evidence outside the regress shadows run. tools/coverage.py reads this only for a shadow
# key that tools/regress.ps1's shadows list does not set: the house regress is the primary source and is used
# whenever it ran the shadow at all. This file covers the shadows that only a lane run has exercised.
#   shadow   the ini key the plugin reads (engine/plugin/FC4*Shadow.cpp)
#   label    the word the source uses for that compared set (a shadow may compare several: fire, riot, ...)
#   clean    lines with every mismatch count 0
#   source   a repo-relative file that records that run; the tool REQUIRES the literal "<label> <clean>/<total>"
#            to appear in it, and refuses the row (a warning, never a credit) if it does not. Numbers are never
#            taken on trust from this file: they are checked against the run that measured them.
#   note     where the run came from
# verified is credited only when EVERY row of a shadow key is exact (clean == total and total > 0). A shadow with
# any inexact set stays unverified: disasters_shadow is listed at its real counts precisely so the report shows
# them instead of implying the disaster layer is proven.
